evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I will be able to build you an accurate quote you can depend on, alright — asked move date, got yes responses.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Julissa), moving date (Thursday October 1st), from Georgetown Texas to Houston Texas, size estimate (700 sq ft, bedroom + kitchen + living room).
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? — asked AFTER all logistics probing was complete, not before.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'Nope. No, not at all' — no concerns raised, N/A.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection offered; customer had no concerns so N/A.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (two story town home), stories (two story both ends), rooms (one bedroom, kitchen, living room, no dining table, no garage/backyard/shed), driveway access (yes, both locations), special items (32-inch TV, large mirror, mattress only for bed).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Do you need our help packing your small items into boxes? Customer said kitchen items only.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: For a typical 700 square footage home, we usually expect to see around twenty to thirty boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical 700 sq ft townhome, 3–5 hrs locally; your case 7.5–8.5 hrs day 1, 2.5 hrs day 2. Estimated total $3,597 including travel fee, overnight fee, packing materials. Anchor + personalized to two-story, overnight drive.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: $208/hr for two movers one truck; fuel, taxes, insurance, wraps, bands, tools all included. Overnight fee $240. Packing materials ~$100 (charged only for used). Travel fee $939. No hidden fees. Minimum 2.5 hours, 15-minute increments after.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved directly to 'And keep in mind we are a time based company...' with no 'Does that feel fair?' check.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money off your final bill.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages. — Mentioned but no explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing; no statement it's built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing question on Two Promises. Rep pivoted to booking offer immediately.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep said 'And would you like me to get you on the schedule or send you an email for now?' — no genuine final concerns probe.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like me to get you on the schedule or send you an email for now? — softened with 'or send you an email' as an easy out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Once you're ready to book there's no deposit record. If you have to reschedule or cancel no fees for that either.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Customer declined to book ('I'm only looking for a quote right now'); no date/phone/arrival window/crew size/addresses/crew notes confirmed.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (two-story properties, specific room-by-room inventory, driveway access, weight/fragile items) and built a fully personalized estimate anchored to the home size and overnight drive requirement.
coaching_note: Move the 'What are your concerns?' question to Section 2 (right after opening framing, before any logistics probing) instead of after all details are collected, and always ask 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing before pivoting to the booking ask — both are load-bearing items in the script.
booking_note: Customer explicitly stated 'No, I'm only looking for a quote right now' and declined to book, saying they would 'let you all know if I'm able to schedule.'
